newsitem.title: USA: Domed stadium in works for Chicago Bears -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Domed stadium in works for Chicago Bears -- paper.

text.p: - Chicago and state of Illinois officials are on the brink of reaching an agreement over a $465 million domed stadium for the Chicago Bears football team, the Chicago Sun-Times reported Friday.
The newspaper said that negotiations with team president Michael McCaskey were all but completed except for whether the stadium would have natural grass or artificial turf.

The financing plan for the stadium would mirror one proposed by Gov. Jim Edgar last year that called for using excess tax revenues supporting bonds for an expansion of McCormick Place convention center, city and state contributions for infrastructure costs, and $175 million from the Bears, the newspaper reported.
